$comment: Name this paper's venue preset in "extends": "paperlint:<name>" for a shipped one, e.g. "paperlint:agenticdev" (`npx paperlint --help` lists them), or a path to your own preset relative to THIS file, e.g. "../../venues/my-venue.jsonc"; add "kind" for its page limit. `npx paperlint new <name> --venue <preset>` writes both for a new paper. Until then the page limit, fonts and format are not checked.
